meta_description: SJM Decorating brings professional interior and exterior painting to Leeds. Expert finishes, reliable service, free quotes. Call 07901 948705 today.
hero_subhead: From tired walls to stunning interiors—SJM Decorating transforms your space with precision and care, start to finish.
services_subhead: Whether you need interior refreshing, exterior protection, or specialist finishes, we deliver professional results on time and on budget.

services.title: Interior Decoration
services.desc: Full room and house redecoration, from feature walls to complete overhauls. We prep properly, use premium paints, and leave your space spotless.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Protection
services.desc: Weatherproof masonry, cladding, and timber using trade-grade coatings. We protect your home against Leeds' climate for years of durability.

services.title: Wallpaper Hanging
services.desc: Expert paper hanging and pattern matching on feature walls or throughout. Includes careful removal of old paper and full wall preparation.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Finishing
services.desc: Doors, skirting, architrave, and fitted wardrobes finished to showroom standard. We use specialist stains and varnishes for a hardwearing shine.

services.title: Commercial Redecorating
services.desc: Fast turnarounds for offices, retail units, and restaurants—minimising disruption to your business. We work flexibly around your operating hours.

services.title: Damp & Problem Wall Treatment
services.desc: Prepare and finish problem walls with breathable coatings and primers that stop moisture returning. Includes full site assessment and advice.

about_pullquote: I paint homes the way I'd paint my own—careful prep, quality materials, and honest timescales.
about_para_1: SJM Decorating was founded on a simple principle: Leeds deserves decorators who turn up on time, finish the job properly, and charge fairly. Over 15 years, we've built our reputation one satisfied customer at a time, completing over 500 residential and commercial projects across the city and its suburbs.
about_para_2: We're known for meticulous surface preparation—the unglamorous bit that separates a paint job that lasts from one that peels. Our clients return because we listen to what they want, deliver it without surprises, and respect their homes as if they were our own.

reviews.text: Transformed our lounge completely. Steve was tidy, professional, and knew exactly what he was doing. Finished a day early and left the place spotless. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David M.

reviews.text: Had the kitchen and hallway redecorated. The prep work was brilliant—they didn't cut corners. Colours look exactly how I wanted them. Fair price, no hidden costs. Will definitely call them again.
reviews.author: Margaret K.

reviews.text: Took on a tricky wallpaper job in our guest bedroom—old paper was stubborn. They sorted it, matched the pattern perfectly, and the finish is immaculate. Professional throughout. Can't fault them.
reviews.author: James T.

address_sub: Serving all of Leeds and surrounding areas including Pudsey, Bramley, and Harrogate
